description: This file provides helper exports for the Lobster plugin SDK, including plugin entry definitions and Windows spawn policies, and imports specific types related to plugin API and tools.

methods.name: definePluginEntry
methods.description: Exports the plugin entry point for the Lobster plugin.

methods.name: applyWindowsSpawnProgramPolicy
methods.description: Applies the Windows spawn program policy.

methods.name: materializeWindowsSpawnProgram
methods.description: Creates or retrieves a Windows spawn program.

methods.name: resolveWindowsSpawnProgramCandidate
methods.description: Resolves candidate programs for spawning on Windows.
